newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Komercni Banka sees lower av CPI in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Czech Komercni Banka sees lower av CPI in 1997.

text.p: Komercni Banka a.s., the Czech Republic's largest commercial bank, said on Friday it saw average consumer price inflation falling this year to between 7.8 and 8.2 percent from 8.8 percent in 1996.
Komercni also saw GDP growth of between 4.4 and 4.8 percent in 1997, compared with its own forecast of GDP growth of 4.1-4.4 percent growth in 1996.
Komercni said in a regular economic forecast it saw the Czech trade deficit widening in 1997 to between 195 billion and 220 billion crowns from 160.3 billion in 1996.
The current account deficit was seen widening this year to 150 billion crowns from the bank's own forecast of 111.3 billion for 1996.
